description: One TestFlight change, straight to App Store Connect (needs a token allowed to submit). values by action — group.create: { name, internal (bool), allBuilds (bool, internal groups) }. group.update: { groupId, name, feedback (bool), allBuilds (bool, internal groups: every build on its own), publicLink (bool, external groups), publicLinkLimit (number or null) }. group.delete: { groupId }. testers.add: { groupId, testers: [{ email, firstName, lastName }] }: Apple emails each one, so from an agent it waits for a person's approval. testers.remove: { groupId, testerIds }. build.whatToTest: { buildId, text, locale (default the app's primary language) }. build.groups: { buildId, add: [groupId], remove: [groupId] } (an external group gets a build once beta review approved it). build.encryption: { buildId, usesNonExemptEncryption }. build.submitBeta: { buildId, label }: sends the build to beta review so external testers can have it; from an agent it waits for a person's approval, and it needs the beta information first. info: { locale, description, feedbackEmail, marketingUrl, privacyPolicyUrl }. review: { contactFirstName, contactLastName, contactPhone, contactEmail, demoAccountRequired, demoAccountName, demoAccountPassword, notes }.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

values.description: The fields for the action, as described above.

name: ploa_testflight_save
title: Change TestFlight
